note: Gaocheng-to-Knezha transfer with four common bands. T1 raw Sequoia bands; T2 Sequoia bands mapped to Gaocheng-equivalent bands with same-band linear maps fitted on PROSAIL spectra; T2m the same with a four-band linear map; T3 training restricted to Gaocheng dates whose Zadoks range overlaps the campaign; T4 = T3 with harmonized bands (T4m four-band map). Reverse scenarios R1-R4m train on Knezha bands treated the same way and predict raw Gaocheng bands. Predictions average five grouped-fold models. Reverse transfer averages four field-grouped Knezha folds. Knezha CIs resample field units; Gaocheng CIs resample 40 m blocks within dates.
